Role: Software Engineer (AI-powered)
Phases:
- Phase 1: Orientation & Ramp-Up (Weeks 1–2)
- Phase 2: POC Kick-Off (Weeks 2–3)
- Phase 3: POC Execution (Weeks 3–8)
3-month target: 2 apps shipped to store

column5: Task / Deliverable

column2: WEEK 1: Foundations + FaceAI Shadowing + Cursor Setup

column5: Set up tooling access: Jira, repos, CI/CD, comms channels
Walk through SE role definition — expectations / autonomy / communication cadence / escalation
Walk through Jira ticket lifecycle end-to-end: creation → refinement → estimation → build → QA → ship
Shadow Filippo in FaceAI ceremonies (observe — dailies / refinement / planning)
column7: Purpose: learn product process — transferable to future apps

column5: Get access to FaceAI repos, pipelines, project boards
Observe PO interactions — how product requirements flow into engineering work
Meet Staff Engineers — understand technical standards / architecture patterns
Meet Lead QA — understand QA process / expectations / dev interaction model
Complete Week 1 company inductions
Set up Cursor and learn core workflows (editing / AI chat / inline edits)
Start reviewing FaceAI PRs using Cursor
column7: Real code — low stakes — good learning exercise

column2: WEEK 2: FaceAI Shadowing Continues + Linting Task Begins + Cursor Deepening

column5: Continue shadowing Filippo in FaceAI ceremonies
Audit FaceAI code quality and review user stories
Audit current FaceAI linting rules — what exists / what's enforced / what's ignored
Use Cursor to fix existing lint violations across the FaceAI codebase
Coordinate with Andrey on CI/CD pipeline — understand current setup
Identify where and how to integrate linter enforcement in the pipeline
Complete Week 2 company inductions
Continue deepening Cursor usage — bulk edits / AI-assisted refactoring

column2: 🎯 MILESTONE: Understands how product works (Jira → PO → Dev → QA → Ship). Has met key stakeholders. Cursor basics solid. Linting audit complete.

column5: Filippo aligns with David on POC scope and success criteria
Filippo briefs Vlad on POC: what the app is / who it's for / what done means
Define together: tech stack / architecture approach / AI tooling strategy
Set up POC project: repo / CI/CD skeleton / project board
Enforce linting rules in FaceAI CI/CD pipeline
Document linting setup for reuse in future apps
Continue FaceAI shadowing (begin tapering as POC ramps up)
Apply product knowledge: create own Jira tickets, write own stories for POC

column2: 🎯 MILESTONE: POC scope defined. Project scaffolded. Linting enforced in FaceAI pipeline. Vlad transitions from observer to builder.

column5: Build core app features independently using Cursor and AI tooling
Lightweight check-ins with Filippo (async-first / minimal meetings)
Interact with Product/QA as needed — as a peer
Manage own Jira board — tickets / status updates / story points
Attend FaceAI ceremonies only if still adding value — otherwise stop

column2: 🎯 CHECKPOINT (End of Week 4): Functional prototype — core features working.

column5: Polish app — edge cases / error handling / UI refinement
Testing — unit tests / integration tests / QA pass
Prepare store submission — assets / metadata / compliance
Ship to store

column5: 8-week retro: what worked / what didn't / data for David
Assess SE role model — is it validated? What needs adjusting?
Define scope for second app

column2: 🎯 MILESTONE: First app shipped to store. Enough data to present SE model to David for Phase 2 strategy.

Filippo checks in with POs and teams on Vlad's integration
Coach on SE-specific skills: autonomous delivery / AI tooling / scope management
